identitySignals: Name matches: the firm's website (k2architects.com) and its X account identify it as K2A Architecture, and it describes itself as an architecture and interiors firm, matching 'K2A Architecture + Interiors (K2A, LLP)'
Has an office at 610 16th Street, Suite 219, Oakland, CA 94612, matching the agenda's Oakland, CA location
Website says K2A specializes in California public education construction and K-12 school design, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' contracts for architectural services
research.notes: Legal name, entity number and EIN not found (LLPs are not in the standard CA Secretary of State business search). The SF office address on the contact page is shown with two different ZIP codes (94103 in body, 94107 in title), so the Oakland office address is used instead. No general email is published on the contact page.

profile.summary: K2A is an architecture and interior design firm based in San Francisco that serves the San Francisco Bay Area and California. It provides services from site investigation and needs assessment through design, construction documents and construction administration. It also does interiors work such as space planning, furniture, wayfinding and signage, and has designed K-12 school facilities.

review.notes: k2architects.com describes an SF-headquartered architecture and interiors firm with K-12 school projects and an Oakland office at 610 16th St, Suite 219 (contact page), consistent with OUSD's Oakland-located architect services agreements; the site does not name OUSD directly, but the distinctive name, location and services fit. Summary, website, headquarters, phone (the SF office line) and the Oakland address are all shown on cited pages and the summary is neutral.
